title: Family Sanctuary — Thera-World Hero (Four Acts, 25s)
description: Cinematic landing hero: African American family of four, mirror chamber → father's resolve → falling together → sanctuary vista → golden fire title. Distinct from thera_world_origin narrative. Use interpolated Studio pipeline; cel-animation composite plates encouraged.

visual_style_anchor.look: Cinematic painterly fantasy illustration matching existing Thera-World hero marketing — NOT anime. Deep jewel-environment depth, volumetric warm light, subtle film grain, epic awe, sanctuary tone (no battle choreography on screen).
visual_style_anchor.skin_lighting_mandate: Warm cinematic lighting on richly rendered Black/African American skin — luminous warmth, amber and umber tonal complexity, deliberate gold fill accents, NEVER flat grayscale or desaturated monochrome skin tones. Preserve dignity and color depth.
visual_style_anchor.family_identity_mandate: All four must read unmistakably as one blood-related family — shared facial-structure cues across generations, plausible natural melanin variation, consistent eye and cheekbone family resemblance across every frame.

casting_locksheet.mother: African American woman late 30s to early 40s. Warm umber skin, natural coily or curly hair in twist-out or braided crown. Long flowing earth-toned dress terracotta deep amber or sage green with subtle West African textile cue (kente or mudcloth at hem or cuffs) reads contemporary not costume. Expression: protective steady matriarch, gravitational center. She notices the mirror tension first.
casting_locksheet.daughter: 11-year-old African American girl pre-teen (must read age 10–12 not younger). Same warm skin-tone family slightly lighter acceptable. Hair: two natural Afro puffs with small colorful beads. Bright sunflower-yellow dress with small visible pockets (keep this look). Waist-up hero framing like her father and brother refs — pre-teen body proportions as in real school photographs of Black girls age 10–12 not toddler not picture-book cute. Expression: wonder turning toward fear conscious curiosity leaning slightly forward as if drawn toward something unseen.
casting_locksheet.son: African American boy 13–15 slightly older than sister. Slightly deeper skin than mother sister showing plausible variation. Short fade or short twists. Graphic tee under unbuttoned earth-toned overshirt dark jeans sneakers. Expression: protector of sister then surprise courage as pulled in emerging man choosing bravery.
casting_locksheet.father: African American man early to mid 40s deep umber skin close cropped hair trimmed beard touches of dignified gray. Tall grounded build fitted henley deep navy forest green or charcoal dark pants leather boots. CRITICAL CHARACTER BEAT ACT 2: first shock registering children and wife vanished into mirror THEN crystallizing UNSHAKABLE RESOLUTE CHOICE NOT HESITATION NOT COWARDICE — deliberate follow into unknown one breath deliberate charge mercury surface arms reaching for family line.
